One current person with significant control is recorded: CORPORATE CONTROLLER 1175, holding 75 to 100 percent of shares and voting rights and the right to appoint and remove directors.
Charges on record: 0 outstanding, 0 part-satisfied and 1 satisfied, 1 in total.
Accounts were last made up to 31 December 2020, and the overdue status of accounts and the confirmation statement is recorded as unknown, with no next due date recorded.
No registered office address changes or officer appointments or resignations have been filed since 24 October 2025.
